description: Electricity access through village grids in rural Senegal - Sustainability success factors and the role of micro-finance is a data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by RWI – Leibniz Institute for Economic Research. Der fehlende Zugang zu Elektrizität hemmt die wirtschaftliche Entwicklung. Seit vielen Jahren verfolgen die Länder in Subsahara-Afrika eine Agenda zur Erhöhung des Stromzugangs in ländlichen Gebieten. Die Erkenntnisse über die Auswirkungen der Elektrifizierung sind jedoch teilweise enttäuschend. Coverage: Senegal. The portal files it under the publisher RWI – Leibniz Institute for Economic Research. Its tags are Energiezugang, dezentrale Energieversorgung, Wirkungsevaluierung, Mikrofinanz, energy access. The repository dates the deposit 2021; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is keine kommerzielle Nutzung. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and electrification planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
